meta.method: WebFetch only (39 fetches); listing text summarised by the fetch tool's model, so occasional transcription slips are possible
meta.coverage_note: Listing pages are cumulative (?offset=N shows N*50 items) and the fetcher truncates pages at ~90k characters (~100-110 cards), so deep pagination could not be read directly. Coverage: /all to Aug 2023; Blogs to Nov 2017; Articles complete (2011-2026, ~98 items); Podcasts, Interviews, Infographics complete; Videos to Jun 2018; Publications to Jul 2020, plus older publications reached via 25 theme search pages. Untagged pre-2020 publications that are not reachable through those theme pages are NOT captured (estimated several hundred more).

field_notes.tags: topic tags shown on the card
field_notes.search_index_tags: theme(s) whose /search?tag_term= page returned the item although the card shows no tags (search-index tagging)
field_notes.countries: card location values; 'SADC' = card label 'Southern African Development Community'. For a few long multi-country lists the fetch tool summarised the list, so treat 14/15-country lists as approximate
field_notes.summary: always null - listings show no summaries
field_notes.seen_on: listing/search pages where the item was found

taxonomy.location_note: 36 country locations in the filter. Cards also show 'Southern African Development Community' (abbreviated SADC in this file) as a location value even though it is not in the Locations filter list. Country codes are ISO3 (e.g. MWI, ZAF) and match /data-portal/<ISO3>.
taxonomy.other_facets_note: No year or language facet anywhere. Language exists only implicitly in titles (English, French, Portuguese, Spanish). Several 'topic' labels are really content types/formats (Annual Report, Briefing Note, Case Study, Focus Note, Technical Note, Implementation Guide, Press release, Multimedia, Questionnaire Design Tool).

counts.displayed_totals: None. No listing or search page shows a total count ('Showing x of y' does not exist). Pagination is a 'Show more' link only.
counts.pagination: Cumulative ?offset=N on each listing (offset=2 -> 100 cards, i.e. 50 per step; podcasts/interviews/infographics show ?offset=2 even when they have fewer than 50 items).

observed.videos_listing_total: 36 (as reported by fetcher; the 4 oldest were not itemised)

counts.estimate_note: Publications are the bulk: legacy file IDs under /system/documents/files/000/000/NNN run from ~134 to ~517, implying ~380+ legacy uploads, plus ~100+ newer files under /Publications/. Total hub is plausibly 700-900 items.

url_patterns.use: listing per content type; types: all, blog, publications, videos, podcasts, interviews, infographics, articles

HTML 'publication' that is really a blog-style page
newer files (c. 2021+); mixed http/https and www/non-www; some names contain spaces (%20)

url_patterns.pattern: external: youtube.com/watch?v=, youtu.be/<id>?si=, youtube.com/embed/, indd.adobe.com/view/<uuid>, nextbillion.net, ventureburn.com, news24.com, cnbcafrica.com, techbuild.africa, centerforfinancialinclusion.org, ropretoria.iom.int, fsdt.or.tz, covid19tracker.africa

problems.no_total_counts_or_year_facet: No result totals, no year/date or language facet, only 'Show more'; deep listings are effectively unreachable for crawlers that cap page size.
problems.search_tag_index_inconsistent: Theme search pages do not match card tags: e.g. 'Barriers to credit for MSMEs' (Aug 2025) shows tags Credit, FinScope MSME, SME financing, but search?tag_term=credit tops out at Feb 2019, finscope-msme at Jul 2020 and sme-financing returns only 2 results; digital-identity returns 3 results (2018) although 2025-2026 blogs carry that tag. Conversely, search pages return publications whose cards show no tags at all. Tag data must be rebuilt from the CMS, not scraped.
problems.publications_mostly_untagged: Almost all Publications (PDFs) display no topic tags on cards; tags exist only for blog/article-style pages.
problems.type_misclassification: Publications listing contains YouTube videos (e.g. SADC FI Forum 2026 Day 1/2, World Bank visit, FinScope SA 2023 launch webinar, Interventions for digital payments), blog-style HTML pages (/knowledge-hub/publications/<slug>?entity=blog), microsites (/GBL/, /Community_digitalisation/*) and a .zip file (/Publications/presentations.zip). Videos listing includes a 'Webinar Recording' while an equivalent item sits under Publications.
problems.entity_param_legacy: URLs carry ?entity=blog|news|event unrelated to the visible type (articles use all three). Redirect map must ignore the param.
problems.external_items: Many items are only external links (YouTube, NextBillion op-eds, Ventureburn, News24, IOM, FSDT, Adobe InDesign online 'indd.adobe.com' publications). indd.adobe.com links are at risk of expiry; they should be downloaded and re-hosted.

problems.taxonomy_overlap: Near-duplicate topics: Digitalisation vs Digitisation; Data vs Data and analytics vs Analytics vs FMT Analytics vs Big Data; SMEs vs SME financing vs MSME Formalisation; Insurance vs Microinsurance vs Funeral Insurance vs Credit life insurance; Financial inclusion vs Financial Inclusion strategies; Survey data vs Survey design vs Data collection vs Research methods; COVID-19 vs COVID-19 Tracker; Cross-border remittances vs Cross Border Traders; SADC as both topic and location. Format labels used as topics (Annual Report, Briefing Note, Case Study, Focus Note, Technical Note, Press release, Multimedia, Implementation Guide).
problems.legacy_brand_content: Large block of 2016-2020 insight2impact (i2i) / DataHack4FI / Openi2i content (articles, interviews) carried over with i2i branding.
